title: Connected-Component Labeling Using HLS for High-Energy Particle Physics Instruments
problem: High-level synthesis (HLS) can reduce FPGA development time, but effectiveness for complex signal processing kernels (like island detection) is unclear.
motivation: Particle physics instruments use FPGAs for front-end processing; HLS promises productivity gains but must validate performance and resource efficiency on realistic kernels.
method: HLS implementation of island detection with 1D/2D configurations and 4-way/8-way connected-component labeling; report resource usage, throughput, and required optimizations.
key_novelty: Empirical evaluation of HLS effectiveness for particle physics signal processing, identifying optimizations needed for high-throughput implementations.
contributions: HLS island detection implementation for gamma-ray telescopes
primary_theme: HLS for particle physics signal processing kernels on FPGAs
